judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation and left an incomplete, broken state where its own acceptance tests in `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` fail because `messageHandler.ts`, `createServer.ts`, and `config.ts` were never updated. Furthermore, the candidate ignored the explicit specification in the issue: it named the frames `list_sessions` and `session_list` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`. Its validation logic also contradicts the ticket by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (the ticket requires integers 1–200), and its planned design in `.lore/dod.md` returns an empty list when `listFor` is missing and omits `transport.history` opt-in and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, directly violating core requirements of the issue. Finally, it committed internal `.lore/dod.md` artifacts and an unfinished CHANGELOG entry.
